interpretation: The mechanism is a degenerate clique, not a uniform shift. Clean HNSW in-degree has a bounded tail (max ~O(M), low Gini); adding one exact-duplicate sink produces a single node whose in-degree is orders of magnitude larger, and a tiny fraction of nodes captures a large share of all incoming edges (Gini jumps; top-0.01% edge share spikes). This is what the scalar max-in-degree summarizes and what collapses greedy navigation.
